CustomField.description:
Formula field used to capture if XBR was met
Case/Ticket: #00015747
CustomField.formula: OR( AND( ISPICKVAL(ClientTier__c, "Maintenance"), XBR_Activities__c >= 1 ), AND( ISPICKVAL(ClientTier__c, "Standard"), XBR_Activities__c >= 1 ), AND( ISPICKVAL(ClientTier__c, "Strategic"), XBR_Activities__c >= 2 ), AND( ISPICKVAL(ClientTier__c, "Managed"), XBR_Activities__c >= 2 ) )
CustomField.label: XBR Met
